name: EventsIntro - The Page's Own Title
description: The /events title and standfirst on their own, with no band around them. It takes no props, but the copy is no longer fixed: the standfirst now names the chapters that actually exist, derived from the published collection the way the nav and the utility bar are. The hand-typed list it replaced had already gone stale, omitting SF and misspelling two other chapters while the menu directly above it was correct. What this frame is for is the relationship between the three parts: a kicker over a left-aligned serif heading over that standfirst, capped at the 760px reading measure. That matters because the component is placed by two different callers, the route above the Luma calendar and EventsPage inside its own section, and has to look identical in both. It was split out of EventsPage so the route could render it ABOVE the embed: the page used to open on Luma's own heading, Full events calendar, so a visitor's first line of text was the third party's rather than the site's.
